theorem Dense.continuous_upperBounds {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIicTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ] {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S)
    (hf : Continuous f) :

  refine subset_antisymm ?_ ?_

    have hrf : range f ⊆ closure (f '' S) := hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS
    have : x ∈ upperBounds (closure (f '' S)) := by

    exact upperBounds_mono hrf le_rfl this
  · exact fun _ => upperBounds_mono (Set.image_subset_range f S) le_rfl

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R₁))
    (h_maps : MapsTo f (ball c R₁) (closedBall (f c) R₂)) (hz : z ∈ ball c R₁) :
    ‖dslope f c z‖ ≤ R₂ / R₁ := by
  have hR₁ : 0 < R₁ := nonempty_ball.1 ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hR₂ : 0 ≤ R₂ := nonempty_closedBall.mp ⟨f z, h_maps hz⟩
  by_cases hcz : dslope f c z = 0
  · simpa [hcz] using (div_nonneg hR₂ hR₁.le : (0 : ℝ) ≤ R₂ / R₁)
  rcases exists_dual_vector ℂ _ hcz with ⟨g, hg, hgf⟩
  have hg' : ‖g‖₊ = 1 := NNReal.eq hg
  calc
    ‖dslope f c z‖ = ‖dslope (g ∘ f) c z‖ := by
      rw [g.dslope_comp, hgf, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_norm]
      exact fun _ => hd.differentiableAt (ball_mem_nhds _ hR₁)
    _ ≤ R₂ / R₁ := by
      refine schwarz_aux (g.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hd) (MapsTo.comp ?_ h_maps) hz
      simpa [hg', NNReal.coe_one] using g.lipschitz.mapsTo_closedBall (f c) R₂

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R₁))
    (h_maps : MapsTo f (ball c R₁) (closedBall (f c) R₂)) (hz : z ∈ ball c R₁) :
    ‖dslope f c z‖ ≤ R₂ / R₁ := by
  have hR₁ : 0 < R₁ := nonempty_ball.1 ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hR₂ : 0 ≤ R₂ := nonempty_closedBall.mp ⟨f z, h_maps hz⟩
  by_cases hc : dslope f c z = 0
  · simpa [hc] using (div_nonneg hR₂ hR₁.le : (0 : ℝ) ≤ R₂ / R₁)
  rcases exists_dual_vector ℂ _ hc with ⟨g, hg, hgf⟩
  have hg' : ‖g‖₊ = 1 := NNReal.eq hg
  calc
    ‖dslope f c z‖ = ‖dslope (g ∘ f) c z‖ := by
      rw [g.dslope_comp, hgf, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_norm]
      exact fun _ => hd.differentiableAt (ball_mem_nhds _ hR₁)
    _ ≤ R₂ / R₁ := by
      refine schwarz_aux (g.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hd) (MapsTo.comp ?_ h_maps) hz
      simpa [hg', NNReal.coe_one] using g.lipschitz.mapsTo_closedBall (f c) R₂

theorem dist_le_dist_of_mapsTo_ball_self (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R))
    (h_maps : MapsTo f (ball c R) (closedBall (f c) R)) (hz : z ∈ ball c R) :
    dist (f z) (f c) ≤ dist z c := by
  have hR : (R : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (nonempty_ball.1 ⟨z, hz⟩).ne'
  simpa [div_self hR, one_mul] using dist_le_div_mul_dist_of_mapsTo_ball hd h_maps hz
